artifacts.public_benchmark_table: Reuse the already sealed public P1 values only; do not rerun or alter public benchmark search.
artifacts.iteration_case_table: Use the fixed S3 case and all seeds 1--10. Show returned cost and CPU minutes for HGS-F, HGS-E, HGS-M and MV-HGS-SP, followed by Min/Avg/Max rows. Numeric values come directly from S3 raw_runs.csv.
artifacts.china81_summary_table: Summarize the complete 405-row formal matrix by the preregistered region and exact-size hierarchy plus Overall. Best and average definitions and statistical comparisons must match the result-strength gate; no instance or seed may be omitted.
artifacts.route_detail_table: Use S4 route_details.csv exactly, with only registered rounding and publication labels; do not hand-fill or recompute a different solution.
artifacts.carbon_profile_figure: Use the sealed 2025-02 city-date-slot carbon-profile source already bound to the runtime authority.
artifacts.iteration_figure: Use S3 curve_data.csv exactly. Draw ordinary straight segments through genuine online complete-model best-so-far observations. Use one continuous time(min)-cost(CNY) coordinate system, no broken axis, smoothing, interpolation, discarded-candidate points, seed replacement or case replacement.

figure4_axis_rule.limits: Compute limits from the complete sealed four-curve data with a fixed 3 percent range margin on every nonzero side; do not crop early points or choose limits from the main method alone.
figure4_axis_rule.line_identity: Use four clearly distinguishable color-line-marker combinations, including a high-contrast HGS-M style. Keep curves visibly separated from axes by the registered margin.
figure4_axis_rule.legend: Concise algorithm names only, no frame, placed where overlap with all four sealed curves is minimal under a deterministic corner-overlap rule; do not move it by visual preference after rendering.

table_presentation_rule: Publisher requirements take precedence. Where the publisher is silent, follow Chen (2025): Chinese three-line tables, consistent full text width, vertically and horizontally centered multirow identifiers, two-level headers with horizontal separation, consistent body/header font sizes, and official table-note syntax. Dense instance-level and layer-level results may be separate panels or separate tables, but no value or row may be hidden.
failure_rule: Any upstream non-PASS, manifest drift, missing row, duplicate row, changed value, endpoint mismatch, hand-entered result, forbidden curve transformation or publisher-format validation failure yields HALT. Presentation may be revised only without changing data, selection, statistics or scientific claims.
